summary: React Query Migration Batch 5 - Tested 5 migrated components. Found and fixed 3 critical bugs. All pages now working.

minor.issue: Returns 404 - endpoint may not exist or user may not have manager permissions

bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: ReferenceError: Cannot access 'leads' before initialization - useCallback for generateMeetingDraftTitle referenced 'leads' variable before it was defined
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Moved the leads useQuery definition BEFORE the generateMeetingDraftTitle useCallback to fix temporal dead zone (TDZ) error

bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: TypeError: leads.map is not a function - leads could be undefined or not an array when API response differs
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Added Array.isArray(leads) checks before .map() and .find() operations (3 locations)

bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: ReferenceError: fetchData is not defined - Refresh button onClick referenced undefined function after React Query migration
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Added refetch: refetchLeads from useQuery and replaced onClick={fetchData} with onClick={() => refetchLeads()}

test_results.MobileAppDownload: PASS - React Query working correctly, stats visible for admin
test_results.HRAttendanceApprovals: PASS - React Query working correctly, pending approvals visible
test_results.ManagerLeadsDashboard: PASS - Fixed fetchData reference bug, Refresh button now works
test_results.SalesMeetings: PASS - Fixed leads TDZ bug and null safety issues
test_results.KickoffMeeting: PASS - React Query working correctly, SOW categories and schedule button visible

critical_code_review_comments: SalesMeetings.js had classic React hook ordering issue - useCallback cannot reference variables defined after it in the component
ManagerLeadsDashboard.js had orphan fetchData function reference - common React Query migration oversight when button callbacks are not updated
Always ensure React Query data has null/undefined safety when used in .map(), .find(), or .filter() operations
context_for_next_testing_agent: React Query Migration Batch 5 complete. 5 pages tested and working. Key bugs fixed: 1) SalesMeetings had leads variable referenced before definition in useCallback - moved query before callback, 2) SalesMeetings had missing Array.isArray checks for leads, 3) ManagerLeadsDashboard had undefined fetchData - replaced with refetchLeads. 60 total components migrated, 28 remaining per main agent note.
